title: Repair dependency policy and tooling drift after Dependabot merges
description: Fix the post-Dependabot main-branch drift without runtime behavior changes: restore Node 24 CI policy and CLI install smoke coverage, update agent dependency guidance, make Biome 2 respect ignored/generated artifacts, tighten Dependabot major update policy, and verify dependency/importer behavior.
acceptance_criteria: CI uses Node 24 and cross-platform CLI install smoke; better-sqlite3 source-build fallback is guarded; AGENTS.md reflects Node 24 / better-sqlite3 12 / @types/node 24; Biome respects .gitignore/generated artifacts; Dependabot ignores semver-major @types/node, Biome, TypeScript, and better-sqlite3; required npm gates pass or limitations are documented.
close_reason: Repaired dependency policy/tooling drift; verification passed: npm ci, npm run check, npm run typecheck, npm run test, npm run smoke:cli-install, focused policy test, and git diff --check. SRD import blocked only by missing local source PDF.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Evidence: existing CI was already on Node 24 with install-smoke matrix and native fallback guard; remaining drift reproduced by focused policy test. RED npx vitest run packages/core/test/nodeRuntimePolicy.test.ts -> failed for AGENTS policy text, Biome vcs.useIgnoreFile, and Dependabot major ignores. GREEN same command -> 5 passed after docs/config/test updates.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
comments.text: Result: npm run check initially failed after enabling Biome VCS ignore because the bd worktree is physically under ignored .worktrees/. Root cause is the script target 'biome ci .'; explicit project paths still respect .gitignore for nested/generated artifacts and let the gate run in bd worktrees. Verification: npm run check -> exit 0; 209 files checked; 7 existing warnings.
